surface: Complete Virtua 0.50.1 React adapter surface for Octane: VList, Virtualizer, WindowVirtualizer, experimental_VGrid, imperative handles, lazy data, dynamic measurement, scrolling, keepMounted, custom container/item/cell elements, and SSR counts. Framework-neutral behavior is delegated to virtua/unstable_core.
divergences: Components are compiled Octane .tsrx modules and receive refs as ordinary props instead of using React forwardRef.
Native DOM event types replace React synthetic event types on viewport attributes.
ssr: VList, WindowVirtualizer, and experimental_VGrid render deterministic ssrCount/ssrRowCount/ssrColCount windows without browser globals.
notes: Pinned to virtua 0.50.1 and reuses its published virtua/unstable_core export.
The full four-component entry measures 9,002 gzip bytes versus React Virtua's 7,461 bytes under the same Vite build, within the binding's explicit 25% initial budget.
Recorded-unverified provenance is retained until every upstream React test identity has a one-for-one adapted counterpart.
